# `company.scheduled_group_authority`

Who last set each memorized group's schedule and mode: the scheduler enters a member only while both the member's author and this setter may, and records the setter on the posting.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `group_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Memorized group whose schedule or mode was set. |
| `set_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | The person or agent who last set the group's schedule, mode or status. |
| `principal_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | — | The person an agent setter acted for; null for a person. |
| `authority_epoch` | INTEGER | yes | — | — | — | — | An agent setter's authority epoch when it set the schedule; null for a person. |
| `set_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time it was set. |
